summary: Executed iteration-58 mutation-focused testing (live + MOCKED unit/UI fixtures). Live flows covered disposable Firebase signup, onboarding register, sub-admin request mutations, main admin decision paths, profile gating, and hard-delete confirmation validation. Critical blocker found: /api/admin/approvals returns 500 due payload assumption, breaking approval inbox-dependent workflows.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when any approval request row lacks payload.submission_id. Stack trace: admin_approvals.py inbox() line 80 KeyError: 'submission_id'.
Approval-dependent mutation cycle (subscription/review/hard-delete) is partially blocked because inbox fetch fails at 500 before selecting actionable request IDs.

minor.issue: Endpoint responds 200 and ~2.06s (batched path appears improved in this run).

ui_bugs.issue: Shows "Request failed with status code 500" on mobile/desktop when inbox API loads.

integration_issues.issue: UI cannot reliably drive approve/reject/profile/document/free-month/hard-delete signoff because /api/admin/approvals 500 aborts request list rendering.
Verified only via MOCKED Playwright network fixture; not counted as full live integration.

issues: Dense tab chips + table content are cramped but still accessible; no blocking overlap detected.
Cookie banner spacer works on public pages (content not hidden behind consent banner).

action_items: Fix admin_approvals.inbox defensive handling for rows without payload.submission_id (skip/enrich conditionally instead of KeyError).
Backfill/sanitize malformed admin_approval_requests rows (especially review/registry_claim kinds) so inbox can render all pending requests.
After inbox fix, rerun full live mutation cycle: sub-admin free-month request -> main approve idempotency/extension, review approve+reject, and hard-delete through approval inbox.
Retest identity_delegate binding assertions post-fix: target bridge/customer_id correctness and immutable main-admin bridge baseline.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_approvals.py inbox() assumes payload.submission_id for every review/registry row; one malformed row crashes entire endpoint (single-record poisoning).
Approval inbox should be fault-tolerant: per-row enrichment failures must not break whole list response.
Some legacy/imported request records are structurally inconsistent with current enrichment expectations; add schema guard/migration.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable Iter58 Firebase users and seeded TEST verification submission fixtures (selfie/document upload bytes) for those disposable accounts only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend mutation pytest already added for iteration58. Current blocker is /api/admin/approvals 500 (KeyError submission_id). Fix that first, then rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iter58_identity_workflow_mutations.py and retest admin UI ApprovalInbox. CommandCenter buyers module is reachable only after creating a trade project. Registry banner was UI-verified with MOCKED network fixture only.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: create/trigger approval requests, then GET /api/admin/approvals as staff/admin. Outcome: 500 Internal Server Error. Backend log shows KeyError in admin_approvals.py line 80 when reading r['payload']['submission_id']. Root cause: endpoint-level enrichment assumes field exists for all review/registry_claim records; malformed legacy/current request docs violate assumption. Mitigation: guard missing payload keys + skip verification enrichment for invalid rows, plus data migration/cleanup for broken request documents.
